The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Bereliz]] led a '''gang''' of pirates and raiders that operated in a [[Unidentified Unknown Regions sector|sector]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The gang operated out of a hidden base and at one point pursued the [[Nebalite]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Grazdoc]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
